cells.gaps: No source found says one national switch connects wallets and bank accounts. Kenswitch calls itself Kenya's domestic switch joining banks and mobile money providers, but Pesalink does the same, and transfers between M-PESA, banks and other wallets pass through several platforms.
cells.note: Rebuild: banks, wallets and telcos interoperate through Pesalink and Kenswitch, so 4. Two switches share the traffic and no source shows either serving every service, so not 5 (Bill, 2026-11-09, message 110).
